conflicts_and_limits: Blanket all-contributions MIT statement cannot supersede third-party figure notices or missing per-file provenance.
Charter explicitly assumes integration with existing workflows and contextual adaptation, not mandatory estate overhaul.
Global-standard ambition, comprehensive coverage and AI-tool vision are not observed facts or certification.
Communications/roles/evaluation are source-program expectations, not assigned local execution authority.
Rights, links, adoption, native proof and independent omission audit remain separate.
